_note: Canonical backlog for Project Io — the authoritative METADATA index of every backlog item
(formerly an OPENS 'Brief'). The rich per-item DESIGN PROSE lives in BACKLOG.md, keyed by id;
this file owns status, priority, difficulty, sequencing and file scope so they are queryable
and cannot drift. One item = one object in `items`.
STATUS (authoritative; the glyph in BACKLOG.md mirrors it 1:1, JSON wins on any disagreement):
designed    (glyph ✓) — design settled, promote-ready. Execution is all that remains.
design-owed (glyph ~) — design still owed; must be settled (into the item) before promotion.
Status is about readiness-to-promote and is orthogonal to priority and difficulty.
PRIORITY (importance, ascending): F C B A S SSS.
F=deferred/parked (revisit later), C=low, B=medium, A=important, S=high, SSS=do-immediately.
`parked:true` is the explicit flag for F-priority items.
DIFFICULTY (1-5, non-linear ~3-4x per step): 1=~5min, 2=~20min, 3=~1h, 4=~3h, 5=~12h+ (break a 5 down).
SEQUENCING: `waits_on` lists other item short_names that must land first; `blocked_on` names a
external prerequisite (a layer/system not yet built). An item can be `designed` and still blocked.
WORKFLOW: a `designed` item is PROMOTED into REFINED.md (the active worklist) and DELIVERED
(the five-step lifecycle — see DELIVERY.md). A `design-owed` item is DESIGNED first (prose settled
in BACKLOG.md, status flipped to designed) before it can be promoted. When work lands, its item is
removed here and the design propagates into the subject's authority doc.
DESIGN PROSE — the `design` field & the markdown/JSON policy (2026-06-16):
- NEW items are authored entirely here: put the design / detail / rationale prose in the
`design` field (a markdown-formatted string). A new item gets NO BACKLOG.md body.
- LEGACY items (migrated from OPENS) keep their prose in BACKLOG.md, keyed by title; their
`design` field is the sentinel "@BACKLOG.md" = 'prose lives in the markdown body'.
- ON PROMOTION into REFINED.md, an item's BACKLOG.md body is DELETED — a refined item must not
have a markdown body. BACKLOG.md therefore only drains, never grows, and is deleted once empty.
- For a design needing rich tables, set `design` to a pointer to the authority doc instead.
Migration note (2026-06-16): this index was extracted from the legacy OPENS.md. The design bodies
currently still carry their old `[priority+difficulty glyph]` markers in BACKLOG.md; those markers
are now NON-AUTHORITATIVE display history — this file is the source of truth for metadata.

items.title: Corporation lens player-tile border is redundant
items.summary: Player tile is filled and outlined the same colour so the border is invisible; recolour the player border (e.g. palette::selection white) for contrast.

items.title: Resolve icon silhouette collisions & contract mismatch
items.summary: Redraw extraction-site as a faceted ore silhouette (off the gem pip) and unit/convoy as a true open chevron; sync icons.cpp + header contract. Design settled in ICONS.md.

items.title: Settle icon outline & colour conventions
items.summary: Every canvas filled marker outlines (pip is the exception); colour=fill for building/faction/corp/unit/pip, stroke for supply/market/ledger/resource-lens. Can land with BL-002 (same files).

items.title: Verify icon usage is consistent across the app
items.summary: Audit every ui::icons::* call site against ICONS.md (right glyph, consistent r/colour, no collisions); fix cheap discrepancies, promote larger ones.

items.title: Reference distances for bodies are rung-relative
items.summary: draw_body_summary should read the distance reference from the current rung (Solar->star 0AU, Circumplanetary->parent 0AU) not hard-code the star. Design settled.

items.title: Implement the hover-card primitive
items.summary: One draw_hover_card dispatcher wrapping the entity_summary builders in BeginTooltip/EndTooltip (SELECTION Focus state); swap the 3 ad-hoc tooltip call sites. Supports Layer 4.

items.title: Time-speed curve + econ-tick progress bar
items.summary: Non-linear speed mapping 1->0.25x .. 5->16x (3=1x reference); drop the quarter-progress bar's xx% overlay. Design settled in TIME_CONTROLS.md.

items.title: Clarify the time control view
items.summary: Production clock: year+quarter+month/day, a worded days-until-next-quarter countdown (Q2 in 47d), speed curve; Space=pause, 1-5=speed via canvas_command. v0.0.8 polish.

items.title: Production / Output lens
items.summary: Planetary lens tinting tiles by production intensity = sum of (output qty x resolved price) across the recipe's products. Design owed: value->opacity normalisation, idle treatment, glyph, legend.

items.title: Placement-suitability surface (a lens on tile selection, not a strip lens)
items.summary: For a selected/armed building type, tint tiles by validity/affinity (valid highlighted, invalid greyed, thrives-here stronger). NOT an overlay_mode. Design owed: trigger, colour treatment, state model.

items.title: Reach / Logistics-range lens
items.summary: Static reach surface (deployment/supply falloff from ports/launchpads). Underdefined until the Supply route model exists; may be a Supply sub-mode. Design owed.

items.title: Meta: per-lens Solar / Circumplanetary representation
items.summary: Design sweep: for each lens decide what (if anything) it shows on the Solar/Circumplanetary rungs. Output is an updated rung-applicability table + per-lens notes. Not a build.

items.title: Lens strip: single-select, nullable, ordered & renamed
items.summary: Lens strip single-select with a null/none state (default Corporation ownership); fix ordering and labels; the strip is a curated subset (others reached via menu/selection). Design owed: order, labels, strip-vs-menu split.

items.title: Supply-routes lens — market-connection graph
items.summary: Graph of trade connections between markets, edge thickness/colour from net trade worth. Aggregate edges once per frame. Blocked on inter-market trades existing. Design owed.

items.title: Market lens → market-boundary UI; relocate the price readout
items.summary: Replace market-price map UI with a market-boundary (catchment tint) lens; keep the price-UI code but move it to a menu/selection-accessed lens. Design owed: boundary rendering, price-lens entry point.

items.title: Lens colour-scheme pass (deferred to a colour session)
items.summary: Board-wide lens colour reconsideration; on-canvas text labels for some lenses; a Corporation-lens legend. Deferred to a dedicated colour session. Design owed: the whole pass.

items.title: Replace Habitability main-lens with Population / Opportunity
items.summary: Replace Habitability on the strip with Population, or a hybrid Opportunity lens (tile max yield ignoring resource/logistics). Per-tile habitability tint stays available. Design owed: which, what max-yield means, legend.

items.title: Scarcity lens — blur to a market-level heatmap
items.summary: Make the built Scarcity lens read as a blurred market-level field rather than crisp per-tile cells; feasibility of a non-tile-bound fuzzy field in immediate mode. Design owed (keep open if infeasible).

items.title: Resource-density lens — uniform colour, deposit-shape
items.summary: Resource lens always single-select, uniform colour (not a gradient), render the whole contiguous deposit shape; test level-as-bloom vs flat. Design owed: contiguous-deposit detection, bloom vs flat.

items.title: Tooltip simplification — lens-specific, why not what
items.summary: Reframe tooltips: less data, lens-specific, explain WHY a system behaves (ledgers are for data). Defer nested tooltips. A large multi-round sweep over every visible entity. Design owed: the per-entity/per-lens content sweep.

items.title: Define the menu items from the systems
items.summary: Wire the nine-slot nav rail in the curated order with the three renames, drop Exploration, add reserved placeholders. Design settled in MENU.md. Promote when the L4 ledger family lands.

items.title: Corporation overview dashboard
items.summary: Nav slot 1 at-a-glance roll-up: Money / Holdings / Production / Alerts (read-only), each a launcher into its ledger. Floating ledger window. Design settled inline.

items.title: Canonical nav-rail ordering rule
items.summary: Curated nine-slot player-facing order (not strict tier order), three renames (Budget / Corp. Strategy / History). Doc-only, settled into MENU.md.

items.title: Tile Ledger default body
items.summary: Default the Tile Ledger's selected body to the current view's main body (active_body / circumplanetary_anchor) rather than lowest id.

items.title: Surface multiple markets in the economy / market ledgers
items.summary: Market read surfaces show each market on a body distinctly (per-market breakdown/selector, '1 of N'), so the tile-centred-markets mechanism is visible. User flagged vital. Design owed: per-market table/selector layout.

items.title: Economy panel — second pass (foundation refit)
items.summary: Refit the L3 debug-dump economy panel to the ledger-family conventions (player-default + corp selector, ledger_chrome, shared builders) so it becomes the convention reference. Foundation of the ledger family.

items.title: Market Ledger
items.summary: Per-body market detail (supply/demand/resolved price per resource, player buys/sells/sell-orders). On-screen counterpart of the Market lens. Parallel-safe with Balance/Construction ledgers.

items.title: Balance Ledger
items.summary: Corporate money loop made legible: income vs expenditure (the four apply_budget flows) + running balance over recent ticks. Deep view the dashboard Money block launches. Parallel-safe with Market/Construction.

items.title: Construction Ledger (construction-in-progress only)
items.summary: Active-construction view (build queue: what/cost/progress); no broad buildings-overview ledger. The v0.0.5 construction_panel scaffold becomes this. Parallel-safe with Market/Balance.

items.title: Non-spatial 'go to' routing
items.summary: For nation/corporation selections, 'go to' opens the relevant ledger via focus_on_entity rather than navigating a canvas. Blocked on those ledgers existing (promoted then cancelled 2026-06-14).

items.title: Canvas hit-testing for buildings / units / markets
items.summary: Add canvas hit-testing for building/unit/market kinds (today only body/tile). Depends on those entities being drawn as selectable markers first (promoted then cancelled 2026-06-14).

items.title: Lens-driven selection resolution
items.summary: Resolve the entity under the pointer through the active lens (specificity stack building->listing->tile->body, lowest valid wins per a lens resolution table) and route to the lens's ledger. Tile/body rows buildable now; marker rows blocked on hit-testing.

items.title: Review the Population + Scarcity lens doc propagation (2026-06-16)
items.summary: Standing review reminder: confirm the LENSES.md Population/Scarcity sections + rung rows, ICONS.md glyph rows, and the multiple-markets SYSTEMS/LENSES wording. All verified live; clear once reviewed.

items.title: Propagate the 2026-06-15 v0.1.0 design pass into the authority docs
items.summary: Settle inline OPENS designs into authority docs. Most propagated 2026-06-15; remaining owed: the LAYOUT.md ledger-family note and the Supply/Layer-5 SYSTEMS+SUPPLY.md settle. Preferential purchasing left to its owning agent.

items.title: Economy warm-start pre-generation pass — surface auto-buy / auto-sell
items.summary: Pre-generation settle so the economy opens at/near steady state, with a legible readout of what is auto-sold (excess) and auto-bought at start. Builds on the v0.0.4 warm-start. Design owed: settle-ticks, the readout.

items.title: Seed multiple market centres from capitals / population
items.summary: Mechanism landed 2026-06-16; remaining is generation seeding >1 market centre per body (today one degenerate market). Design owed (deferred to population layer): centre count/seeds + Market lens per-catchment tint.

items.title: Preferential purchasing (choosing counterparties)
items.summary: Replace pooled clearing with a per-(body,resource) matched ORDER BOOK (price-time priority, EMA anchor price preserved) + a buyer counterparty preference (ranked/avoid as a matching bias). Contracts/tariffs deferred to v0.2.0. Blocked on Layer 5 reachability.

items.title: Inter-body / international markets
items.summary: Each body keeps its own market/price; bodies couple ONLY through Supply convoys (market-to-market, mode-gated, Euclidean space distance). First build is a minimal feasibility probe of the coupling alone (no space gameplay). Blocked on Layer 5.

items.title: Supply routing — convoys (Layer 5)
items.summary: Convoy entity (source/dest market, mode, cargo, progress, per-unit-distance logistical cost); auto-dispatch default, player-directed exception (space launches MUST be player-directed). Umbrella; decomposes 1->2->3->4 serial + 5 (lens) disjoint. The largest remaining v0.1.0 build (a 5); v0.0.7's whole theme.

items.title: Resource generation — full-set deposit authoring + scarcity (v0.2)
items.summary: Extend deposit authoring from the 7-resource subset to the full raw set via a seeded per-resource rarity scalar [0,1] (raw-tier only) modulating frequency/magnitude over terrain affinity. Scheduled to v0.2; data-only.

items.title: Habitability gates max workforce, not production directly
items.summary: Habitability caps a building's max workforce fraction (not output directly): >~0.6 -> 100% base; below, reduced. Tech later raises above 100% (0.99 -> ~250%). Design owed: the curve, the over-100% tech model.

items.title: Workforce pool & population coupling — step 2 (population-derived supply)
items.summary: Step 1 landed 2026-06-15. Step 2: replace authored pool supply with one derived from population centres (population -> labour force -> share contracting to the corp); wage level tracks habitability/pressure. Best taken with/after the static MVP.

items.title: Building rules — stricter placement & a per-building justification process
items.summary: Placement too loose (buildings infinite, Port anywhere). Define stricter per-building rules (counts/terrain/adjacency/finite slots) + a user-approved per-building justification table; building-ledger-as-secondary-window direction. USER RESPONSE REQUIRED. Design owed.

items.title: Construction pricing — buildings cost resources (per-building, approved)
items.summary: Buildings cost resources to construct, set per-building and user-approved (a documented cost table). Couples to the labour/material split and the construction spend. Design owed: the per-building cost table + approval pass.

items.title: Logistics network & infrastructure model
items.summary: Infrastructure gates+costs each convoy mode (land<sea<air<space): land ungated (road=optional tile-attribute cost-reducer), sea gated on Port, air on Airfield (deferred building), space on Launchpad+Orbital Port. Capacity deferred. Emanation 'fuel' model noted as the growth direction (Shadow Empire feel).

items.title: Layer 4 — population centres + building management (index)
items.summary: Umbrella index (NOT promotable) over the population + building-management layer. Fully decomposed 2026-06-15 into its child items (POPULATION_STATIC_MVP, POPULATION_DYNAMIC, WORKFORCE_POOL_STEP2, the ledger family, BUILDING_MANAGEMENT). No design owed at this level.

items.title: Population centres — static MVP (Briefs 1–5)
items.summary: Unblocked foundation root of the v0.0.6 Layer-4 goal. Static scope: (1) land_use foundation, (2) population-centre model + habitability-clustered generation pass, (3) population demand into markets, (5) agglomeration bonus. 1->2 serial; 3 and 5 disjoint dependents of 2.

items.title: Population centres — dynamic half (Briefs 6–7)
items.summary: (6) habitability aggregate + feedback (body habitability -> workforce efficiency) and (7) population growth (habitability/met-demand -> level change over Ticks). First indirect feedback loop. Best after the static MVP + workforce pool.

items.title: Building management — functional recipe & workforce control
items.summary: Interaction half of 'manage buildings': recipe selector (valid recipes per building_type), per-building workforce target/cap feeding contention, decommission (refund material/charge labour). Build cost splits labour+material in economy.lua. Lives in the tile Selection building view, not a nav slot.

items.title: Generate the saturated nation-owned background substrate
items.summary: Per-tile nation-owned industry field aggregated into a per-(nation,body) market interface (no per-building entities), laid down by a slot/resource-consuming pass (population-seeded ripple, leading approach), dynamic + displaceable, surfaced as an industry-density lens. Primary direction settled; residual sub-design owed (generation home, growth model, slot/capacity, lens visual).

items.title: Tile generation refinements (deferred — deep models owed)
items.summary: Generation-mechanics passes only (deposit data half moved to RESOURCE_GENERATION_FULL_SET): smooth band transitions + coastline refinement (buildable, cosmetic, deferred) and speculative orbital-derivation + tectonic landforms (design owed, beyond v0.1.0).

items.title: Rename Faction → Country (doc- and code-wide)
items.summary: Rename the Faction-presence lens to Countries and propagate faction->country where it means nation. Caveat: faction_colour() is the CORPORATION colour, not the nation lens, so disentangle faction-as-nation from faction-as-corp-colour. Design owed: term boundary + sweep list.

items.title: Country generation — more countries, generated 'in history'
items.summary: More countries than today's Voronoi partition, with a sense of history: v0.1.0 target is clustering seeds with a varied size distribution (some larger, some smaller). Couples to SATURATED_SUBSTRATE. Design owed: clustered-seed sizing, what 'in history' means, count target.

items.title: Deferred — nation behaviour & production passes
items.summary: The nation SYSTEM (tax, licences, war, infrastructure), sentiment graph, historical fragmentation (exclaves/disputed zones), non-Kepler jurisdiction. Out of prototype scope; design owed when in scope.
